descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Key Features

# Play Music in Mixed Reality

Enjoy the app in both mixed reality and virtual reality bring any music instrument in your environment and produce high quality music. You don't need to be cut off from your surrounding
[media]

# No Piano is Required
[media]
 Experience the joy of playing not just the piano but any instrument without the need for an actual instrument. **Mapiano XR** allows you to immerse yourself in Mixed Reality or virtual space where you can practice, learn, and create music using just your VR headset.



# Drums Set

Experience Mapiano XR Dynamic Sound as you play drums.
Produce your own amapiano beats and share with friends
The app is designed to deliver high-quality sound, as
if you were playing on a real instrument. 
[media]


# Strings

Produce sounds of any string music instrument ranging from the Spanish guitar, violin, cello, harp and many more..


**Music Player Gramophone**

Load and play sound on 
the classic gramophone. simply click 
load sound on the disc and load any mp3 
or sound file. Place the disk on to
the gramophone and click play.

[media]



********Upload Your Own Music Sheets******** 

With Mapioano XR, you can easily upload
music sheets in image format. Simply 
capture a photo of your sheet music or
scan it, and the app will allow you to 
play your desired melodies directly in 
the virtual environment.
This feature gives you the freedom to 
upload and play any music composition.
